::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 17 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (1):  p. 1
:::

My dear Miss Yonge	
[I](people/person_939.qmd) have given our printer orders to go on with the '[Clever Woman](cmy_books/cmybook_58.qmd)'. I hope you will receive proofs at once & have a rapid supply. It will make some such work as '[The Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd),' as you wish.

I have corresponded with a friend of yours about '[Events of the Month](organizations/other_69.qmd).'[^1] I think the idea admirable the want is a crying one. But it should be [*illegible*] and well carried out. I hardly see my way to the right plan.

I have several times wished there was a [Don Quixote](other_books/otherbook_32.qmd) in our Series. I see you have been telling the story briefly, and you recommend the one in Unwin’s Englishman’s Library. Is it very well done? I almost wish you would do it some day. But we should not lose sight of the more important book

ever dear Miss Yonge
Yours faithfully
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: It seems that CMY had suggested to the [Henrietta Murray](people/person_1073.qmd), the editor of *Events of the Month* that Macmillan might take it over from the Mozleys who published the last number in January 1865..
